privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: How we collect, use and protect your information.

whoWeAre.heading: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: Holy Auramaxxxing (“Aura”, “we”) is a small, grace-centred app run for friends walking together toward freedom. For anything about your data, contact our grievance officer at the address below.

whatWeCollectAndWhy.heading: What we collect, and why
whatWeCollectAndWhy.body:
Account details: your email address, the display name and handle you choose, your time zone and your theme. We use these to run your account. If you sign in with Google, we keep only your email address from Google, not your name or photo.

Your profile: the photo, bio, testimony and favourite verse you add, shown only to the people you choose.

Your answers at sign-up: that you confirmed you are 18 or older, which policy version you agreed to, and when.

Check-ins, mood, urges, triggers and notes, once you start using them. These reveal private parts of your life, so we treat them as sensitive personal data and only process them with your explicit consent.

Group membership and what you post in a group, shown only to that group's members.

Security records: sign-ins, password changes, exports and deletions, with a rough device name such as “Chrome on Android”, kept for one year to protect your account. We do not keep your IP address: our sign-in provider sees it while you sign in, and we clear it within the hour.

whatWeNeverDo.heading: What we never do
whatWeNeverDo.body: We never sell or share your information, never show ads, never use trackers or fingerprinting, and never use what you write to train AI. We only set cookies that the app needs to work.

whoProcessesDataForUs.heading: Who processes data for us
whoProcessesDataForUs.body: Supabase (database and sign-in, hosted in Mumbai, India), Cloudflare (bot protection), Google Cloud Vision (checks uploaded profile and group pictures for explicit images; it receives only the picture), Google (only if you choose to sign in with Google), our email provider, and our web host. Each processes data only on our instructions under a data processing agreement.

howLongWeKeepIt.heading: How long we keep it
howLongWeKeepIt.body: While your account is open. If you delete your account, we wait 14 days in case you change your mind, then permanently delete your personal data. Anything you posted in a group is anonymised. Backups roll over within 30 days.

yourRights.heading: Your rights
yourRights.body: You can see, correct, download and delete your data, withdraw consent, and nominate someone to act for you, from Settings or by writing to us. We reply within 30 days. You can also complain to your data protection authority, such as the Data Protection Board of India.

children.heading: Children
children.body: The app is only for adults. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18, and the sign-up does not create an account for anyone who says they are under 18.

grievanceOfficer.heading: Grievance officer
grievanceOfficer.body:
For any question or complaint about your data, contact our grievance officer: Paulz, paulangelogamer@gmail.com. We acknowledge every message within 7 days and aim to resolve it within 30 days.

If you're not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India or your local data protection authority.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lede: The simple rules for using the app together.

whoCanUseTheApp.heading: Who can use the app
whoCanUseTheApp.body: You must be 18 or older and give honest answers when you sign up.

notAMedicalService.heading: Not a medical service
notAMedicalService.body: The app supports your journey with check-ins, encouragement and Scripture. It does not diagnose or treat any condition and is not a substitute for a counsellor, doctor or pastor. If you are in crisis, contact a local helpline or emergency services.

lookingAfterEachOther.heading: Looking after each other
lookingAfterEachOther.body: Be kind, keep what others share in confidence, and never post sexual content. We remove content and accounts that break these rules, and we report child sexual abuse material to the authorities.

yourAccount.heading: Your account
yourAccount.body: Keep your password safe and tell us if you think someone else has used your account. You can delete your account at any time.

changes.heading: Changes
changes.body: If these terms change in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before the change takes effect.

yourData.title: Your data, in plain words
yourData.lede: A short, honest summary of what happens to what you share.

privateByDefault.heading: Private by default
privateByDefault.body: Nothing you do is public. Your profile is only visible to people in your groups, field by field as you choose. Check-in details are shared only at the level you pick for each group.

discreetEverywhere.heading: Discreet everywhere
discreetEverywhere.body: Browser tabs, emails and notifications use the neutral name “Aura” and never mention what the app is about.

yoursToTakeOrDelete.heading: Yours to take or delete
yoursToTakeOrDelete.body: You can download everything as a file, or delete your account. Deletion is final after 14 days.

protected.heading: Protected
protected.body: Your sign-in uses secure, encrypted cookies. Passwords are checked against known data breaches without ever sending your password anywhere. The most sensitive notes are encrypted before they are stored.

This is a copy of everything Aura holds about you.

data.json has everything in one file. The csv folder has the same information as one spreadsheet per topic. Times are in UTC.

checkin_only.description: The group sees whether you checked in today, nothing more.

streak.label: Streak
streak.description: Also your current streak and your level.

full.label: Full
full.description: Also how each day went. Honesty is never shamed here.

invite_only.label: Invite joins
invite_only.description: Anyone with a working invite joins straight away.

request_to_join.label: Admins approve
request_to_join.description: An invite sends a request, and an owner or admin approves it.

covenantInfo.title: The covenant
covenantInfo.hidingAllowed: Members may hide from the leaderboard.
covenantInfo.explain: This is what everyone in the group agrees to. You may share more than the minimum, never less.

create.lede: A small group of people you trust, walking the same road together.
create.reviewLede: You can change the name, description and picture any time. Changing the covenant later needs everyone's agreement if it asks more of them.
create.pictureLater: You can add a group picture once the group is started.
create.defaultCovenant: We will check in honestly every day, pray for one another, and keep what is shared here inside this group. A slip is met with grace, never shame.

fields.name: Group name
fields.nameHint: {min} to {max} characters. Only members and people you invite see it. It shows at the top of their screens, so a plain name keeps things discreet.
fields.descriptionHint: A line or a verse that sets the tone. Up to {max} characters.
fields.startDateHint: Day 1 of the challenge, in the group's time zone.
fields.timezoneHint: The group's day starts and ends in this time zone.
fields.maxMembersHint: Small groups work best. Between {min} and {max}.
fields.covenantHint: What everyone agrees to when they join. {min} to {max} characters.
fields.minShareLevelHint: Everyone shares at least this much with the group. Members may choose to share more.
fields.hidingAllowed: Let members hide from the leaderboard
fields.shareLevel: What you share with this group
fields.leaderboardHidden: Hide me from this group's leaderboard
fields.confirmName: Type the group's name to confirm

home.todayBody: Check-ins for today will show here, at the level each member shares.
home.leaderboardBody: The group's leaderboard arrives with check-ins and streaks.
home.wallBody: Encouragement, prayer requests and testimonies will live here.
home.togetherBody: Your group's clean days, added up, will show here.
home.archivedBanner: This group is archived. Everything is kept, but nothing new can happen here.
home.inviteNudge: It's just you so far. Invite the friends you trust.

proposal.title: A change to the covenant
proposal.lede: The owner would like to change what everyone agrees to. It only takes effect if every member agrees.
proposal.youAgreed: You agreed. Waiting for the others.

members.removedHint: Someone removed can't join again with an invite until you allow them back.
members.confirmOwner: Make {name} the owner? You'll become an admin.

invites.lede: Invite the friends you trust. Each invite works for a while, and you can stop it any time.
invites.createdOnce: This is the only time we can show this link and code: we keep only a scrambled copy, so nobody can read them from our side. Share them now, or make a new invite later.
invites.codeHint: For typing in: Groups, then Join with a code.
invites.qrLabel: QR code for the invite link
invites.uses: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used once} other {Used # times}}
invites.confirmRevoke: Stop this invite? Anyone holding it won't be able to join with it.

settings.lede: Your place in this group, and the group itself.
settings.membershipLede: The group's minimum is {level}. You may share more.
settings.leaveBody: You can leave at any time. Nothing is kept about your membership.
settings.ownerLeave: As the owner, hand the group to someone else before you leave, or archive or delete it.
settings.covenantLede: Relaxing the covenant applies at once. Asking more of members (a higher minimum, no hiding, or new words) needs every member to agree first.
settings.transferTitle: Hand the group to someone else
settings.transferHint: They become the owner and you become an admin.
settings.transferNone: Once someone else has joined, you can hand the group to them.
settings.archiveBody: Keeps everything, but nothing new can happen: no invites, no joining.
settings.deleteBody: Deletes the group and everything in it for everyone. This can't be undone.

picture.title: Group picture
picture.hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 5 MB. We remove location and camera details, and check every picture before members see it.
picture.pending: Checking the new picture. It will appear here once it's ready.
picture.rejected: We couldn't use that picture. Please choose a different one.
picture.cropDescription: Use the sliders to choose what shows inside the square.
picture.heicUnsupported: This browser can't open HEIC pictures. Please choose a JPG or PNG, or use Safari on your iPhone.

join.title: Join a group
join.signedOutBody: Create an account or sign in to see the group's covenant and join.
join.approvalNote: An owner or admin will approve your request.
join.requestedBody: An owner or admin of {name} will look at your request. It will appear under Groups once they approve it.
join.alreadyRequested: You've already asked to join {name}. An owner or admin will look at it.
join.removed: You can't join {name} with this invite. Ask an owner or admin to allow you back.
join.codeLede: Type the short code someone shared with you.
join.noInvite: Ask someone in the group for an invite link or code.

status.invalid: We couldn't find that invite. Please check the link or code, or ask for a new one.
status.expired: This invite has expired. Please ask for a new one.
status.revoked: This invite was stopped. Please ask for a new one.
status.used_up: This invite has been used as many times as it allows. Please ask for a new one.
status.full: This group is full for now. Please talk to the person who invited you.
status.archived: This group is no longer taking new members.

notices.created: Your group is ready. Invite the friends you trust.
notices.allowedBack: They can join again with an invite.
notices.transferred: You handed the group over. You're now an admin.
notices.covenantProposed: Your change is proposed. It applies once every member agrees.
notices.covenantAgreed: Thank you. Your agreement is recorded.
notices.covenantNowApplies: Everyone agreed: the new covenant applies.
notices.covenantDeclined: You didn't agree, so the covenant stays as it was.
notices.joined: Welcome! You're in. Say hello when you check in.
notices.requested: Your request is sent. An owner or admin will look at it soon.

errors.nameLength: Use 3 to 60 characters for the name.
errors.descriptionTooLong: Keep the description to 500 characters or fewer.
errors.covenantLength: Write the covenant in 10 to 2,000 characters.
errors.startDateOutOfRange: Choose a start date from a month ago to a year ahead.
errors.timezoneInvalid: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.maxMembersTooLow: The group already has more members than that.
errors.maxUsesRange: Choose between 1 and 500 uses, or leave it empty.
errors.textInvalid: This contains characters we can't show.
errors.choiceInvalid: Please choose one of the options.
errors.codeInvalid: That doesn't look like an invite code. It has 10 letters and numbers.
errors.codeRateLimited: That's a few codes in a row that didn't match. Please wait 15 minutes, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: That's a lot in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save that just now. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the group's owner or admins can do that.
errors.archived: This group is archived, so it can't be changed.
errors.full: This group is full for now.
errors.alreadyRequested: You've already asked to join this group.
errors.removed: You can't join this group with an invite. Ask an owner or admin to allow you back.
errors.inviteInvalid: We couldn't find that invite. Please check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.inviteExpired: This invite has expired. Please ask for a new one.
errors.inviteRevoked: This invite was stopped. Please ask for a new one.
errors.inviteUsedUp: This invite has been used up. Please ask for a new one.
errors.emailUnverified: Please confirm your email address first, using the link we sent you.
errors.accountClosing: Your account is closing, so you can't join or start groups.
errors.covenantNotAccepted: Please read the covenant and tick the box to accept it.
errors.covenantChanged: The covenant changed while you were reading. Please read it again.
errors.shareLevelTooLow: This group asks everyone to share at least its minimum.
errors.hidingNotAllowed: This group doesn't allow hiding from the leaderboard.
errors.ownerMustTransfer: As the owner, hand the group to someone else first, or archive or delete it.
errors.cannotTargetSelf: You can't do that to yourself.
errors.targetNotMember: That person isn't in the group any more.
errors.invalidInput: Something in the form isn't right. Please check it and try again.
errors.tooManyGroups: You're in as many groups as we allow for now.
errors.tooManyInvites: This group has as many working invites as we allow. Stop one first.
errors.nameMismatch: Type the group's name exactly to confirm.
errors.proposalClosed: That change is no longer open.
errors.avatarType: Please choose a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC picture.
errors.avatarSize: Please choose a picture under 5 MB.
errors.avatarUnreadable: We couldn't open that picture. Please try another one.
errors.avatarTooSmall: That picture is very small. Please choose one at least 64 pixels wide.

form.honest: Either answer earns the same reward. Honesty is what counts.
form.detailsHint: Fill in any of these, then choose your answer below.
form.noteHint: Encrypted. Only you can ever read it. Up to {max} characters.
form.answeredSlipped: Your answer: you slipped, and grace covers it.
form.changeUntilToday: You can change it until the end of today, and tomorrow until 12:00.
form.changeUntilNoon: You can change it until 12:00 today.

errors.signedOut: Please sign in again to check in.
errors.accountClosing: Your account is closing, so check-ins are paused.
errors.windowClosed: That day can’t be changed any more. You can answer for today, and for yesterday until 12:00.
errors.invalid: Something in that answer didn’t look right. Please try again.
errors.notFound: There’s no check-in for that day yet.
errors.saveFailed: That didn’t save. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: That’s a lot of changes in a short time. Please wait a little and try again.

done.title: Thank you for checking in
done.lede: One more day walked in freedom, one day at a time.
done.verseText: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ.

mercies.title: His mercies are new this morning
mercies.status: Saved. Thank you for being honest.
mercies.lede: A slip resets a streak, never you. You are forgiven, and you are not alone.
mercies.verseText: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
mercies.reflectionLede: Optional, and private to you. Noticing the pattern helps the next streak grow longer.
mercies.reflectionSaved: Saved. Only you can read it.
mercies.prayerTitle: You don’t have to carry this alone
mercies.prayerBody: Tell someone you trust and ask them to pray with you. Soon you’ll be able to ask your group or your partner to pray from right here.

breathe.title: Breathe for a minute
breathe.body: Tap the SOS button and follow the breathing. Let your body settle before you decide anything else.

walk.title: Step outside
walk.body: Put your phone in your pocket and walk for ten minutes. A change of place helps.

verse.title: Read one psalm
verse.body: Psalm 51 was written for days like this. Read it slowly, out loud if you can.

message.title: Message a friend
message.body: Send one honest line to someone you trust. You don’t need to explain everything.

kept.slipTitle: Your streak may have reset today, but look at everything you kept
kept.pausedTitle: Your streak paused, but look at everything you’ve built
kept.cleanDays: {count, plural, one {# clean day} other {# clean days}}
kept.streaks: {count, plural, one {# streak built} other {# streaks built}}
kept.longest: {count, plural, one {longest streak: # day} other {longest streak: # days}}
kept.body: Every one of those days was real, and none of them is undone. Today can be day one of the next streak.

stats.label: Your streaks
stats.ringValue: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, toward your longest of {longest}

today.title: Your check-in
today.notYet: You haven’t checked in today yet.
today.doneClean: You checked in today: you stayed free.
today.doneSlipped: You checked in today. Grace covers it.

progress.title: Your journey
progress.lede: Private to you. Nobody else can see this page.
progress.chartEmpty: Add a mood or urge strength when you check in, and your chart will appear here.
progress.chartAlt: Line chart of your mood and strongest urge over the last {days} days. The same numbers are in the table below.
progress.tableCaption: Mood and strongest urge by day
progress.triggersEmpty: When you note what played a part in a day, it will be counted here.

insights.notEnough: {needed, plural, one {One more check-in} other {# more check-ins}} and patterns will start to show here.
insights.freeDays: You stayed free on {clean} of the {total} days you checked in.
insights.urgesWeekdays: Urges run stronger on weekdays than at weekends.
insights.urgesWeekends: Urges run stronger at weekends than on weekdays.
insights.urgesOnDay: Strong urges come most often on a {weekday}. Plan something good for that day.
insights.moodRising: Your mood has been lifting lately.
insights.moodDipping: Your mood has dipped lately. It might be a good week to lean on your group.
insights.lowMoodUrges: Urges tend to be stronger on low-mood days. Be extra kind to yourself on those.
insights.hardDayTrigger: On the harder days, “{trigger}” came up most.

group.title: Today
group.shareNote: Each person shows only what they chose to share with this group.
group.streak: {count, plural, one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}
